mapper.select: SELECT id, name, age, username, role FROM user
SELECT id, name, age, username, role, phone, email, address, bank_name, bank_account_number, bank_account_holder FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, age, username, password, role, phone, email, address, bank_name, bank_account_number, bank_account_holder FROM user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (name, age, username, password, role) VALUES (#{name}, #{age}, #{username}, #{password}, #{role})
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name=COALESCE(#{name},name), age=COALESCE(#{age},age), phone=COALESCE(#{phone},phone), email=COALESCE(#{email},email), address=COALESCE(#{address},address), bank_name=COALESCE(#{bankName},bank_name), bank_account_number=COALESCE(#{bankAccountNumber},bank_account_number), bank_account_holder=COALESCE(#{bankAccountHolder},bank_account_holder) WHERE id=#{id} AND role='BUYER'
